settings.title: What is Pro Stock
settings.text: A diesel class with limits on engine and turbo. “The Evil One” runs a Cat 3208 V8, 680 CI, at 10,000 lb.

settings.title: What is a full pull
settings.text: The sled gets harder to drag the farther it goes. Reach the end of the track and it’s a full pull.

settings.title: Competition or exhibition
settings.text: A competition counts for the class standings. An exhibition is a run for the crowd, no points on the line.

settings.title: Arrive early
settings.text: Grandstands fill before the first class. Come early for a good seat and a look at the pits.

settings.title: Bring ear protection
settings.text: Pro Stock tractors are loud. Ear plugs or muffs for everyone, kids first.
